scope: Frozen raw-output protocol; composite assessed separately.

boundary_artifacts.observations: Straight deliberate patch edge with a thin light/dark rim and slight softness. No severe tearing, doubled contours, anatomy damage or obvious blue spill. Composite restores the outer region exactly; the generated inner rim remains.

production.boundary_quality: PASS_WITH_MINOR_ARTIFACTS; no feathering; inside pixels identical to raw.

limitations: Single fixed-seed case, not a backend-wide success rate.
